<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NATIVE-022:android-provider-20261030 -->
## Verified resolution — all three original criteria pass

The provider/output repair is on `development/preview-hardening` (production fix `d95a0502131ca5113888e0ee29a9d596b8879645`). Public API/packages and null/default authority are retained; all Android23+ captures now use validated grantable FileProvider URIs. Missing/wrong setup reports explicit failure; the recommended root is camera-only.

1. **Minimal consumer, correct/missing/wrong setup on API23 and24+: PASS.** Real public Compose consumer, Android provider/XML/foreign-UID writes, default/custom authority and configuration failures execute on API23 and35.
2. **Custom authority and no installed/available intent handler: PASS.** Actual implicit capture with zero available native handlers reports launch failure without output/delivery; exact system-camera enabled state is restored, including Android6 DEFAULT (not silently changed to ENABLED).
3. **Narrow owned root: PASS.** Unrelated cache sibling cannot be granted; native system-created grants, readable output/closed descriptors and cancellation-only ownership are checked.

Reviewed evidence: [API35 four passes](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41073167954), [API23 three accepted passes](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41087017676), and [only the failed API23 case, freshly passing](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41090899608) at `76f6054c2c5128965aeeb03f8b21855e3e195748` (1/1 native, one fresh XML, Gradle0/73.02s). Eight accepted target executions of four methods across two APIs; successful unchanged results were reused, not replayed. Earlier overall failed runs and the failed fourth API23 method remain failed/unaccepted.

Scope: controlled enforcing AVD/source consumer with synthetic bytes/recipient selection, not camera hardware/vendor UX, physical devices, packaged Maven/ABI or release/security clearance. #13 lifecycle/process-restoration, #80 large-photo profiling and other readiness gates remain open. No packages, releases, deployment or Pages. Original technical body/labels/upstream PR274 attribution are preserved; this closes only NATIVE-022 after original-criteria review.
